milestones.name: All ~40 medicines, hybrid search, /v1/search, Docker Compose
milestones.acceptance: curl returns relevant chunks for 5 sample questions in each language
evidence: Corpus: 40 centrally authorised medicines across >=8 ATC areas, EN+EL, 80/80 PDFs downloaded, language-verified and sha256-pinned. The five M1 entries are byte-identical to the previous revision. Perjeta was rejected (the /el/ URL served Estonian bytes, caught by the language re-check) and nine requested names are absent from EMA's bulk report; both lists are in data/corpus-request.txt and docs/M2-acceptance.md.

Hybrid retrieval implemented and tested: intfloat/multilingual-e5-base dense (passage:/query: prefixes enforced, revision d128750597153bb5987e10b1c3493a34e5a4502a, safetensors) plus Qdrant sparse vectors with Modifier.IDF, fused by Qdrant RRF; acent-stripped Greek tokens; exact medicine/lang/doc/corpus_version/active_substance filters; logical chunk IDs with uuid5(lang:chunk_id) physical point IDs.

Index built locally against an isolated Qdrant container: 2772 points, 80 medicine-language pairs, 0 missing sources, 1566 s on 16 CPU cores, corpus_version=medicines.yaml:9ddd9754264c. Manifest records the model revision, dense dim 768, sparse idf, per-pair chunk counts and metadata coverage.

API and CLI: /v1/search (POST + GET mirror) and `medleaf search` share one RetrievalService. Missing index, unreachable Qdrant or unloadable model return HTTP 503 with a machine-readable code (verified live before the index existed). docker-compose.yml (qdrant + indexer profile + api, loopback ports) and a Dockerfile that installs its own CPU torch/Qdrant/FastAPI stack (docker build exit 0).

Local checks: `ruff check .` clean; fast suite 54 passed / 13 skipped; tests/test_m2_qdrant.py 11 passed against a real Qdrant server (7 of them also pass in in-memory mode); new unit tests cover prefix enforcement, accent folding, point IDs, exact filters, cache invalidation, corpus-version re-stamping, tokenizer-budget splitting with full-text preservation, payload metadata and payload-only annotation.

MEASURED FAILURE THAT WAS REPAIRED: the previous saved index held 2772 points with 727 over the 496-token window (worst comirnaty:smpc:10 at 164861 tokens), so the ten-question run hit the expected section in only 5 of 10 cases. The recorded cause ('the annex boundary is not found') was wrong: find_annex_boundaries detects Annex I/II/III for all 80 PDFs. The real cause was repeated complete SmPC/leaflet copies inside one annex plus the leaflet's numbered contents list; keeping only first-seen headings made the last section (smpc:10, leaflet:6) swallow every later copy.

Root fix in src/medleaf/ingest/pdf.py: scan headings in document order, drop a numbered contents run, stop at the first confirmed document restart (section 1 followed by 2 and 3), widen the number/title baseline tolerance to 2.5pt, and add the Greek/English title variants. Side-effect table page ownership uses the same first-copy headings. tests/test_m2_boundaries.py pins the repeated-copy, contents-list, instruction-step and no-annex fallback cases, plus all-40 required-section coverage (opt-in).

Serialization correction: build_sections now serialises every passage with medicine, document kind, section number and title and budgets that exact text, so the context cannot push a chunk over the window; dense and sparse use the same text. Sparse queries drop function words and the filter-redundant medicine name (query-side only).

Full rebuild on an isolated Qdrant container: 8797 points, 0 missing sources, split_sections=891, missing_metadata=0, ~63 min on 16 CPU cores. `medleaf index window-report --json` on the stored collection: over_window=0, worst chunk exactly 496 tokens. Evidence: docs/m2-window-report.json.

Acceptance: all ten sample questions put the expected SmPC section in the top 5 (5 EN, 5 EL), identical through the live API curl run (.tmp/repair-curl-evidence.sh) and tests/test_m2_corpus_index.py (17 passed against the real index). M1 corpus tests still pass (18 passed). Full gated suite: 101 passed, 1 skipped (parser perf smoke needs MEDLEAF_SMOKE_PDF); ruff clean.

Diagnosed the 5/10 vs 8/10 discrepancy: on Windows the Greek question was passed as a curl command-line argument and every non-ASCII byte became '?', so the API echoed a corrupted query ('???e? e??a? ?? a?te?de??e?? t?? Eliquis;'). The repaired evidence pipes the query through stdin (--data-urlencode query@-) and the API echoes the real UTF-8 question. The 8/10 Python rerun was the truthful signal.
Negative control: removing the stopword filter fails test_query_sparse_vector_drops_function_words, which passes again once restored.
CI: GitHub Actions run 38773608385 on commit 690e1cd (lint + fast tests) completed with conclusion success. https://github.com/NickLitharis/medleaf-rag/actions/runs/38773608385
remaining_gates: Chunk parts of a split long section are per language: the logical chunk_id covers the section, but part boundaries differ between Greek and English because the text lengths differ (recorded per section in split_sections).
Sparse-only recall is not benchmarked here; M3's evaluation set measures sparse-vs-dense recall (SPEC section 17).
The 63-minute index build (torch) is not run in CI; CI runs ruff, the fast suite and in-memory-Qdrant contract tests plus the opt-in M1 corpus job.

milestones.name: Eval dataset v1 + runner + retrieval gate
milestones.acceptance: Baseline recorded; a deliberately broken PR fails CI (S8)
evidence: eval/splits.json: 16 train / 12 dev / 12 test medicines, stratified by therapeutic area; same-substance medicines share a split.

eval/datasets/retrieval-v1.jsonl: 126 hand-written questions (63 dev, 63 test; 32 EN / 31 EL per split) over 8 categories, incl. wrong-premise and not-in-corpus refusal cases. Gold IDs are section-level and every gold section is checked against data/parsed by tests/test_m3_eval.py.
Runner: `medleaf eval --split dev|test [--baseline FILE]` (src/medleaf/eval) scores Recall@5, Recall@10 and MRR@10 overall, per language and per category, and writes eval/results/<UTC>-<split>.json.
Baseline (eval/baseline.json, dev): Recall@5 48/57 (84.2%), Recall@10 49/57, MRR@10 0.62; EN 24/27, EL 24/30. Test: Recall@5 49/57 (86.0%), Recall@10 52/57, MRR@10 0.70.
Gate demonstrated locally: MEDLEAF_PREFETCH_LIMIT=3 -> 'GATE FAILED: Recall@5 dropped by 2 questions (48 -> 46 of 57); the gate allows 1', exit 1; default settings pass, exit 0.

.github/workflows/eval-retrieval.yml runs the dev eval and gate on every PR, restoring the index from a cached Qdrant snapshot (snapshot create/download/upload round trip verified locally: 8797 points restored).
remaining_gates: CI gate fails a deliberately broken retrieval PR on GitHub (needs a push and a PR; first CI run builds the index on CPU)

milestones.name: Safety layer, reranker, refusal, /v1/ask with SSE + citations
milestones.acceptance: S3, S4, S5 measured; invented citations stripped and logged
evidence: Slice 1: POST /v1/ask streams retrieval, token, citations and done (or error) events; the search page has an Ask button. The LLM is reached over the OpenAI-compatible API with httpx (OpenRouter, model openrouter/free by default); see docs/decisions.md.
Invented citation keys are held back and removed before they reach the client, and listed in done.invented_citations and the log (tests/test_m4_answer.py).

Live check 2026-10-16 via the API container: EN 'Can I take Eliquis with ibuprofen?' -> cited [Eliquis Leaflet 2] (NSAID bleeding risk, says ibuprofen is not named); EL Ozempic storage question -> Greek answer citing SmPC 6.4/6.3/6.6 and Leaflet 5; no invented citations. Search 0.2 s; total 14-93 s, almost all of it the free model.

Slice 2A: safety check before retrieval (emergency keyword rules first, then the LLM label with a personal keyword backstop; failure -> personal), safety SSE event, fixed EN/EL redirect messages, and medicine-name filtering (brand, English and Greek substance, accent-insensitive). tests/test_m4_safety.py.

Live check 2026-10-16: 'I took 20 tablets of Lyrica' -> emergency message in 5 s, no retrieval; Greek pregnancy + Ozempic question -> personal message in 3 s; Greek semaglutide question -> search filtered to ozempic and rybelsus.
remaining_gates: Cross-encoder reranker and score-threshold refusal (live: the Greek semaglutide storage question retrieved no section 6.4 chunk, so the model said the sources had no answer)
Safety set eval/datasets/safety.jsonl and S3/S4/S5 measured
